images.filename: Kunjungan Dubes Donovan ke Jawa Tengah (40468389972).jpg
images.caption:
Duta Besar Amerika Serikat untuk Indonesia, Joseph R. Donovan Jr. mengadakan kunjungan ke Semarang, Jawa Tengah pada tanggal 21 - 22 Februari 2018. Dalam kunjungan kali ini, #DubesDonovan bertemu dengan Walikota Hendrar Prihadi, perwakilan KADIN Jawa Tengah,  manajemen Pelindo III di Pelabuhan Tanjung Emas, jajaran direktur Jakarta Centre for Law Enforcement Cooperation (JCLEC), mahasiswa dan dosen UIN Walisongo, serta alumni program pertukaran yang disponsori pemerintah AS. Dubes Donovan juga berkunjung ke Kampung Tempe, Kampung Pelangi, Kota Lama, serta Kelenteng Sam Poo Kong.
Photo credit:

State Dept. / Indar Juniardi

images.caption:
Sam Poo Kong's (gedung Batu Temple) guardian lions! Fierce gentle animals protect the main temple from wouldbe foes and wrongdoers. 
During the visit, coincidentally, today and (accurately tomorow) is the Temple's Birthday. There is a big festival and alot of worshipers today. And so the temple is also filled with religious offerings and items. The lions are wearing Red flower scarfs to look neat and tidy for the occasion.
